image_description: A close-up view of a textured, parchment-style paper menu. The top features a decorative illustration of a red pitcher and glass with floral motifs. Below the illustration is a header that appears to read 'Appetizers' in a stylized font, followed by several lines of item descriptions and prices. The text is heavily distorted and illegible, resembling gibberish or pseudo-text rather than real words. The lighting is warm and slightly uneven, suggesting an indoor restaurant setting.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text is completely nonsensical. Characters melt into each other, stroke widths vary randomly within single letters, and no real words are formed. This is a catastrophic failure for a document-based class.
The edges of the pseudo-letters bleed slightly into the background texture, lacking the sharp ink-on-paper boundary expected of printed material.
The pitcher and glass in the top illustration have slightly warped geometry and indistinct handles/rims, typical of AI struggling with complex reflective objects.
